title: Computer Science.
description: Develop programming, computational thinking and understanding of computer systems required for GCSE Computer Science.

sections.title: Systems Architecture
sections.text: CPU components, Von Neumann architecture, memory types and storage devices.

sections.title: Networks
sections.text: LAN and WAN, internet protocols, network topologies, cyber security threats and prevention.

sections.title: Data Representation
sections.text: Binary, hexadecimal, character encoding, images, sound and compression.

sections.title: Programming Fundamentals
sections.text: Variables, selection, iteration, arrays, subroutines and defensive design.

sections.title: Algorithms
sections.text: Sorting and searching algorithms, flowcharts, pseudocode and computational logic.

sections.title: Ethical, Legal and Environmental Issues
sections.text: Data protection, computer misuse, copyright and environmental impact.
